content.short: Ratio Finance provides DeFi risk assessments to help consumers make smarter decisions.
content.description: Ratio Finance was established in 2021 with seed capital from investors including Alameda Research, CMS, and Solana Labs. The service centers on risk-aware DeFi participation, using Risk Rating Algorithms to identify and mitigate potential risks associated with decentralized finance. These algorithms help users earn yields on deposited liquidity provider (LP) positions while leveraging that collateral to unlock additional opportunities. The approach blends risk assessment with yield optimization, enabling more efficient use of deployed assets within the protocol.
